findings.desc: Coverage gap: several verificationIntent slots are recorded as covered, but the cited smoke tests do not assert the exact boundaries. CHK-001 edge: validation-protocol-smoke.ts:67-74 checks non-timeout failure status/code and lines 101-110 check the positive timeout diagnostic, but there is no assertion that non-timeout failures omit timeoutMs recovery guidance. CHK-002 adversarial: verification-freshness-smoke.ts:488-495 asserts the marker, hash-binding phrase, and recovery commands, but no test pins the required wording that stale evidence does not necessarily mean verification logic failed. CHK-004 edge: flow-stability-smoke.ts:2177-2205 covers the missing delivery-check fallback hint, but no smoke path exercises the existing delivery-check hash-mismatch or unverified docsPromise recovery branches in done-oracle.ts:467-487. CHK-005 edge: legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke.ts:170-204 covers codex doctor CLI and lines 215-222 cover unsupported session_brief/aux_doc_list suggestions, but there is no CLI assertion that lattice codex verify still resolves to verify_codex. Add focused assertions for these intent refs before the test-coverage lane passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Added focused smoke assertions for non-timeout validation failures, stale-evidence wording, delivery-check hash mismatch and unverified docsPromise hints, and codex verify alias help. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, test:validation-protocol, test:verification-freshness-smoke, test:flow-stability-smoke, and test:legacy-koala-compatibility-smoke.
